title: Bench Note on Re-Opening a Commission for an Agreed Change
content:
# Bench Note on Re-Opening a Commission for an Agreed Change

Where a change is agreed on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions, what re-opening the commission at the bench is charged at turns on whether the commission stands expedited and on whether a stage of production stands recorded on it.

## The rates

1. Where the commission stands expedited and a stage of production stands recorded on it, re-opening the commission at the bench is charged at the programme's rush surcharge rate on the value of the work the customer has committed to.
2. Where the commission does not stand expedited and a stage of production stands recorded on it, re-opening is charged at 10 per cent on that value.
3. Otherwise nothing is charged for re-opening the commission at the bench.

Whether the customer asked for the commission to be expedited stands on the commission record. A stage of production stands recorded where at least one production stage entry has been booked to the commission.

## The programme's rush surcharge rate

| Programme | Expediting surcharge rate |
|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 18 per cent |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 18 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 22 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 25 per cent |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 22 per cent |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 30 per cent |

## Readings (hypothetical)

Take a value of the work committed to of USD 2000.00 and a commission with a production stage recorded.

| Commission | Rate | Charge for re-opening |
|---|---|---|
| A Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission standing expedited | 25 per cent | USD 500.00 |
| A Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission not standing expedited | 10 per cent | USD 200.00 |
| Any programme with no production stage recorded | — | Nothing is charged for re-opening the commission at the bench |
